reason: first agent run, stopped at ~290 updates; superseded by the gate-entropy-floor architecture and the 5,000-update budget
finding: Both runs collapsed through the GATE while direction entropy stayed at 0.64-0.68 and its dual never engaged: 2023 seed 11 to 100% long, 2024 seed 11 to 100% flat. Diagnosis: the entropy target was on the direction, the one factor that never moved. Also established that the counterfactual objective cannot rescue a collapsed policy (cf_actor_loss falls to 1e-7 as the softmax Jacobian carries pi_b), and that 400 updates gave 12,800 actor gradient steps against a 156,240 reference.
superseded_by: gate entropy dual at 0.0138 nats, 5,000 updates, actor 128 / critic 256, sequence 256, annealed lr, per-pass advantages
